source_files.title: N-best T5: Robust ASR Error Correction using Multiple Input Hypotheses and Constrained Decoding Space
source_files.evidence_location: PDF Sections 2-4, constrained-decoding methods; p. 4 Tables 1-4 and Figure 5
source_files.evidence_en: LibriSpeech, Table 4: baseline clean/other WER 2.88/7.06%; 10-best T5 unrestricted 2.67/6.56%, N-best constrained 2.54/6.31%, lattice constrained 2.53/6.27%. No measured streaming word-delay/RTF result was found in the inspected paper.
source_files.code_note: An exact author implementation and checkpoint were not confirmed in this bounded review. This does not establish their absence.

source_files.title: Can Generative Large Language Models Perform ASR Error Correction?
source_files.evidence_location: PDF Section 3 methods; Section 4.1 setup; Table 2 and error-analysis Tables 3-6
source_files.evidence_en: Table 2, LibriSpeech test-other Conformer-Transducer: WER 6.90 to 6.24% for one-shot closest mapping; Whisper small.en 7.37 to 7.03%. On TED, unrestricted zero-shot correction of Whisper worsens 3.89 to 5.84%. The historical model is gpt-3.5-turbo-0613.
source_files.code_note: An exact author implementation and checkpoint were not confirmed in this bounded review. This does not establish their absence.

source_files.title: HyPoradise: An Open Baseline for Generative Speech Recognition with Large Language Models
source_files.evidence_location: Publisher PDF pp. 4-8, benchmark/methods and Tables 1-3; p. 20 Appendix Table 6 and failure-case discussion
source_files.evidence_en: Table 2 reports cross-domain WER benefits. Appendix Table 6, LibriSpeech: baseline clean/other 1.8/3.7%; H2T-LoRA 1.7/3.8%, H2T-ft 1.8/3.9%. Larger language models do not yield a universal gain on this strong baseline.
source_files.code_note: Official benchmark/code repository confirmed; its data, models and evaluation were not downloaded or run. The collected publisher PDF is the evidence version.

source_files.title: Listen Again and Choose the Right Answer: A New Paradigm for Automatic Speech Recognition with Large Language Models
source_files.evidence_location: PDF Sections 3-4, Figure 2; p. 6 Tables 1-2; pp. 7-8 calibration and post-processing ablations
source_files.evidence_en: Table 1 SpeechGPT branch: CommonVoice WER 14.4% baseline, 13.7% raw ClozeGER, 12.4% calibrated and 8.5% after post-processing. Table 2 text-only branch reaches 8.6%. Final gains cannot be assigned to selection alone or acoustic input alone.
source_files.code_note: The paper points to the HyPoradise repository, which is accessible. A separate complete ClozeGER implementation/checkpoint was not confirmed in that review.

source_files.title: ProGRes: Prompted Generative Rescoring on ASR n-Best
source_files.evidence_location: Collected v2 PDF pp. 2-3 methods; p. 4 Table 1 and Sections 5.1-5.2
source_files.evidence_en: Table 1, GPT-4 expansion: CommonVoice ASR1/ASR2 WER 40.84/9.32%; Section 5.1 baselines are 42.94/12.38%. The prose reports 9.82 for ASR2, conflicting with the table. Original-list ProGRes gives 42.84/11.42% without generated additions.
source_files.code_note: Official code/data repository and IEEE publication metadata confirmed. Code, API inference and author metrics were not reproduced.

source_files.title: Generative Speech Recognition Error Correction with Large Language Models and Task-Activating Prompting
source_files.evidence_location: PDF Sections 3-4; p. 6 Tables 2-4 and Figure 5 discussion
source_files.evidence_en: Table 3, frozen InstructGPT with TAP: WSJ WER 11.87 to 8.72%, ATIS 8.82 to 6.39%. Tables 2 and 4 separate prompt variants and fine-tuning; those are distinct conditions.
source_files.code_note: An exact author implementation and checkpoint were not confirmed in this bounded review. This does not establish their absence.

source_files.title: Delayed Fusion: Integrating Large Language Models into First-Pass Decoding in End-to-end Speech Recognition
source_files.evidence_location: PDF pp. 2-3 Algorithm 1 and retokenization; p. 3 Section IV-A/Table I; p. 4 Tables II-III
source_files.evidence_en: Table I, LibriHeavy 50kh, CTC-prefix mode: no LM clean/other WER 3.47/6.41%, RTF 0.018; OpenLLaMA-3B delayed fusion 3.05/5.68%, RTF 0.115. RTF uses the first 200 lh-other utterances on Xeon+V100. Table II exposes an accuracy-cost frontier.
source_files.code_note: An exact author implementation and checkpoint were not confirmed in this bounded review. This does not establish their absence.

source_files.title: SALSA: Speedy ASR-LLM Synchronous Aggregation
source_files.evidence_location: PDF pp. 2-3 coupling/decoding; p. 4 Tables 1-3 and Runtime Complexity
source_files.evidence_en: Section 5 runtime: A100-80GB RTF Whisper 0.42, SALSA 0.64, Whispering-LLaMA 1.30. Table 1, eight selected FLEURS languages: LoRA Whisper average WER 39.4%, SALSA-7B on the fine-tuned recognizer 33.0%.
source_files.code_note: Official training/inference repository confirmed. No dependency installation, model download or execution was performed.

source_files.title: StreamCorrect: Self-Supervised Error Correction for Real-Time ASR with Offline Recognizers
source_files.evidence_location: PDF pp. 3-5 method/setup; p. 6 Table 2; p. 7 deployment discussion and p. 8 limitations
source_files.evidence_en: Table 2, AISHELL-1 100ms chunks, SimulStreaming to StreamCorrect: CER 27.3 to 11.7%; first-token latency 158 to 207ms, last-token latency 200 to 284ms on NVIDIA H20. At 500ms CER 16.3 to 9.8%, FTL 158 to 219ms, LTL 213 to 295ms.
source_files.code_note: Official repository confirmed; its README uses a different subtitle from the published paper. Code and metrics were not reproduced.

source_files.title: It's Never Too Late: Fusing Acoustic Information into Large Language Models for Automatic Speech Recognition
source_files.evidence_location: Collected arXiv v1 pp. 4-6 methods/setup; p. 7 Table 1; p. 8 Table 2
source_files.evidence_en: Table 1: GER baseline ATIS/WSJ WER 1.61/2.83%; static late fusion 1.36/2.55%, UADF 1.24/2.47%. Early/mid fusion comparisons and uncertainty ablations are also reported.
source_files.code_note: Official repository and model-card pointers confirmed. OpenReview PDF download returned HTTP 403, so the collected evidence version is the author arXiv v1 with an ICLR-2024 publication header.
